desc: The total number of shares or equity units held by the insider after the reported transaction is executed
Price per share/unit at which the transaction was executed; if a range is involved; this is the minimum price
The total number of shares or equity units covered by the transaction
A numerical score (1 to 3) indicating the importance or potential market impact of the trade; with 1 as low and 3 as high significance
Total monetary value of the transaction in its original currency (i.e.; price times number of shares traded)
Total value of the transaction converted to Euro currency; for comparability across markets
Three-digit ISO code indicating the national currency in which the transaction occurred (e.g.; EUR; USD; GBP)
